mapper.select: SELECT CODE_TYPE , CODE , CODE_NM , DTL_EXPL FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{value} ORDER BY CODE_NM

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM CLOVER_ROLE_USER A , CLOVER_ROLE_PAGE B , ( SELECT PAGE_ID , PRIV_ID FROM CLOVER_API_PAGE WHERE API_URL = #{apiUrl} ) C WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND B.ROLE_ID = A.ROLE_ID AND C.PAGE_ID = B.PAGE_ID AND C.PRIV_ID = B.PRIV_ID

SELECT T2.PAGE_ID , T2.PRIV_ID , T3.PAGE_KEY FROM ( SELECT * FROM CLOVER_ROLE_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) T1 , CLOVER_ROLE_PAGE T2 , CLOVER_PAGE T3 WHERE T2.ROLE_ID IN (T1.ROLE_ID) AND T2.PAGE_ID = T3.PAGE_ID GROUP BY T2.PAGE_ID, T2.PRIV_ID, T3.PAGE_KEY ORDER BY T2.PAGE_ID
